name: hl-bead-studio-video
description: Records the README video from the running app (decisions 0026 and 0027).

scripts.video:demo-dry: playwright test --grep @demo-dry && node cues.mjs out/demo-dry && node compose.mjs out/demo-dry --cut-gaps
scripts.video:groq: playwright test --grep @groq && node cues.mjs out/groq && node compose.mjs out/groq --cut-gaps --readme
